children: Jefferies updated investors that its recent channel checks of Target

stores indicated that customers appear highly responsive to promotional offerings across multiple categories, a positive sign for the retailer. Seasonal and category merchandise initiatives were also noted to be driving engagement.
Analyst Corey Tarlowe and his team observed strength in the apparel department at Target

stores, which appeared well-presented and well-stocked. "We also observed a clear customer response to promotional activity across several categories. Multiple items bearing promotional signage or markdown stickers appeared to have lower inventory levels than surrounding merchandise, suggesting consumers continue to engage with value-oriented offerings," wrote Tarlowe.
Looking ahead, Tarlowe continues to believe investors might not be factoring in the magnitude of Target's
merchandising transformation and the potential for it to support sustained traffic growth and margin expansion over time.
Jefferies has a Buy rating on Target

title: Target is winning back more customers with value offerings, organized stores
